text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing major...
My temples are just throbbing a little, is all...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Tsk, did I catch a chill
after my bath yesterday...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Instead of standing around in the night breeze,
I should've just dried my hair sooner...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Brian-senpai with her hair flowing
in the night breeze...?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa!
That's so cool! It's definitely gonna be awesome!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, Narita Brian continued to be plagued by a headache...
